headline: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Round of 32
items: RESULT: England 2-1 DR Congo — Harry Kane's late brace (75', 86') rescues the Three Lions after Cipenga's 7th-minute shock; England set up a last-16 tie with Mexico
RESULT: France 3-0 Sweden — Kylian Mbappe's brace fires Les Bleus into the last 16
RESULT: Mexico 2-0 Ecuador — Quinones and Jimenez send the hosts through at a roaring Estadio Azteca
RESULT: Ivory Coast 1-2 Norway — Erling Haaland's 86th-minute winner books Norway's spot
RESULT: Netherlands 1-1 Morocco — Morocco advance 3-2 on penalties (Germany also out to Paraguay 4-3 on spot-kicks)
TODAY: Belgium vs Senegal (4:00 PM ET, Seattle); USA vs Bosnia-Herzegovina (8:00 PM ET, San Francisco Bay)
NEXT: Spain vs Austria, Portugal vs Croatia & Switzerland vs Algeria close out the Round of 32 on Thursday
GOLDEN BOOT: Mbappe leads on 6 (ahead of Messi on assists); Haaland one back on 5; Dembele & Vinicius Jr chase on 4
